lines.t: Only in glory
Eyes like fire
Breaking through the midnight sky
Thunder on the waters
Every distant star replied
Robes of blinded whiteness, wrapped in uncreated light
Nations start to tremble at the drawing of your sight
Mountains fall like sand under the weight of your name
Heaven's floor is shaking, every angel in flames
Mercy in your whisper, but a sword in your breath
Glory in your eyes and only tearing your steps
This is the heat in dreadful splendor
Grown in the storm in burning thunder
Heaven and earth on their faces under
The weight of your glory, the weight of your glory
Radiant terror, consuming fire
Love like an ocean, wrath like a choir
Lifting your power higher and higher
The weight of your glory, the weight of your glory, oh
Glory, oh
All of your glory, yeah
All of your glory, yeah
Every crown falling down before your story, oh
All of your glory, glory, oh
All of your glory, yeah
Yeah, yeah
Smoke fills the temple, thresholds shake with living sound
Seraphim are crying as the pillars all fall down
Train of your own, flooding worlds yet to be named
Dust becomes a mirror, catching echoes of your flame
Woe to the proud when your holiness appears
Every secret spoken, every hidden naked fear
Coil upon the lips, ashes spilling from our hands
Under by the gaze of the one before we stand
This is the king in grandeur
Dreadful splendor
Gold in the storm
Burning thunder
Heaven and earth on their faces under
The weight of your glory
The weight of your glory
Radiant terror
Consuming fire
Love like an ocean
Wrath like a choir
Lifting your power
Higher and higher, the weight of your glory, the weight of your glory
Glory, glory, glory, terror, fire
You come in power
Glory, glory, terror, fire
You come in power, the final hour
Undone, I am undone
In the halls of your throne
One word from your mouth and the ruins are a-
Smoking sapphire, thundering glass
Worlds fall silent as the ages pass
Galaxies spin on the edge of your hand
Worlds fall quiet when you rise to stand
Voices of a million suns breaking your roar
Every knee crashing down on the floor
Holy, your glory
Holy, your glory
Holy fear in the heart of creation Every breath is a silent confession
All we build falls away in a moment Only your glory, only your glory
This is the king of the dreadful splendor A cloud in the storm and a bird in thunder
Heaven and earth on their faces under
The weight of your glory, the weight of your glory
When you appear, no shadow will remain
Beauty and terror in a single name
Love that can shatter, love that can save
Fall to our faces now
While it's still today
Thank you.
